reason: Losing that $9,000 kitchen job still stings, so I'd call the demo line, but I'm not putting $2,000 up front plus $249 a month on a robot answering my customers until I've heard it handle a real messy call. If it tells a client something wrong or drops an appointment, I lose more than I save.
objection: A machine giving my customers a wrong answer or messing up a booking under my company name, and me paying a $2,000 setup before I know it actually works for my calls.
would_change_my_mind: A trial month without the $2,000 setup, or the setup refunded if it doesn't catch at least one job I'd have missed, after I hear it handle my own test calls in Québec French.
